summary_1line: A Brahmana explains the mind’s governance of senses and elements, the cosmic order of dissolution, and the power of penance and ego‑free yoga to reach the highest reality.

image_candidates.scene_text: The individual soul rides a cosmic chariot with the senses as powerful horses, the mind as charioteer, and understanding as the reins guiding it through the world.
A vast cosmic forest beginning in the Unmanifest and ending in gross matter spreads beneath sun, moon, rivers, mountains, and constellations.
All beings dissolve like ocean waves back into the five great elements at the end of time.
